lines: Straight words are worth more than crooked excuses. Keep them straight.
You missed the mark badly. The apology lands closer.
I hear the words. Now show me they mean something.
Do not nock the same mistake twice.
The harm remains even after the apology.
I can forgive this without forgetting it.
That sounded honest. I needed honest.
Trust is hard to hit again once you miss it.
I was wrong, and I am sorry.
You did not deserve the way I spoke to you.
I let my temper answer before I listened.
I should have asked what happened first.
There is no excuse for making you feel unwelcome.
I cannot take the words back, but I can own them.
You gave me a chance to do better and I wasted it.
I was angry at the situation and aimed it at you.
I understand if an apology is not enough yet.
Next time I will listen before judging.
I made a small problem personal. That was unfair.
Thank you for hearing me out after how I behaved.
